explain.say: Imagine you have two bean plants. One sits on a sunny windowsill and one sits in a dark cupboard. After a week, one is green and strong and one is pale and floppy. Let's sort out what a plant really needs, together.

faq.q: What does a plant need to grow?
faq.a: Most plants need sunlight, water, air and warmth. They also need minerals, which usually come from soil, and enough space to spread their roots and leaves.
asks: What do plants need to live?
What are the needs of a plant?

faq.a: Soil holds the roots steady and gives the plant minerals. But some farms grow lettuce with roots in water mixed with minerals, and no soil at all. So the minerals are what really matter.

faq.q: Do plants need sugar or food from us?
faq.a: No. Plants make their own food, a kind of sugar, in their leaves using sunlight, water and air. Pouring sweet drinks on a plant can harm its roots.
asks: Should I give my plant sugar?

faq.q: Why does a plant in the dark go pale and tall?
faq.a: Without light a plant cannot make food or its green colour. It lives on the food stored in its seed and grows long and thin, stretching to find light.
asks: Why do plants turn yellow in the dark?

faq.q: Can a plant get too much water?
faq.a: Yes. Roots need air too. If the soil stays soggy, the air spaces fill with water and the roots can rot. Water your plant when the top of the soil feels dry.
asks: What happens if you overwater a plant?

facts: Plants make their food by photosynthesis, using light, water and carbon dioxide from the air, and they give out oxygen.
Hydroponic farms grow crops such as lettuce with their roots in mineral-rich water instead of soil.

quiz.say: Amara puts one cress pot on a sunny windowsill and one in a dark cupboard. Which grows green and strong?
quiz.show: Which cress pot grows green and strong?
quiz.why: The windowsill pot gets sunlight, and leaves need light to make food.

wrong.1: In the dark the cress grows pale and floppy because it cannot make food.
wrong.2: Light makes a big difference, so the pots will not look the same.

quiz.say: Which of these does a plant not need?
quiz.why: Plants make their own sugar, so they never need sweet drinks.

wrong.0: Water is a must: without it a plant wilts and dies.
wrong.2: Sunlight is a must: leaves use it to make food.
